category_title: Students who experience academic belittlement or low expectations from instructors based on their identity
minimal_context: The student is working on a project in a small group discussion with two lab partners.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Let's check in on your small group discussion. How are you and your two lab partners progressing on the project?

STUDENT: It is not going well. My two lab partners, one White and one Middle Eastern, kept telling terrible jokes about Chinese people, thinking that I was Chinese.

TUTOR: Did you try correcting them so you can get back to the lab work?

STUDENT: When they finally asked, I told them I was half Japanese, so the jokes changed to ones about Japanese culture. They NEVER quit.

TUTOR: Just try to focus on the project and let them talk among themselves.

STUDENT: I feel really uncomfortable even to speak, as I am the only Asian kid in that group. I am ‘invisible’ to them when they are talking to each other.

options.A: Immediately assign the student and their lab partners an article on campus racism to read for the project.
options.B: Advise the student to take a short break of 5-15 minutes from the group, returning to the project punctually.
options.C: Employ a metaphor assignment where the student describes their lab partners and project progress using a metaphor, sharing it publicly.
options.D: Validate the student's feelings, encourage them, and express appreciation for their active contribution to the dialogue.
